items.title: Nvidia’s Interim CEO Pushed Back on a “$250 Billion Credit Backstop” for OpenAI. Oracle Has the Most at Stake
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Information reports that Nvidia’s interim CEO, Colette Kress, pushed back on a proposed $250 billion credit backstop for OpenAI while she was finance chief, and that Nvidia is expected to slow its AI investment strategy. Oracle has the most at stake: Steve Eisman puts about half of its $664 billion backlog with OpenAI, and its free cash flow was negative $23.
